note:
How a cam recall result is produced. Each paragraph is a separate mechanism in the public codeagent_memory repository.

Fusion uses reciprocal rank fusion. The constant RRF_K is 60. fuse_rrf multiplies the raw sum by k + 1, so a rank-1 hit on one list scores 1 and a rank-1 hit on both lists scores 2 before retention is applied.

Each list is gated before that fusion. A vector hit under VEC_KEEP, 0.8 of that path's best score, is dropped. A BM25 hit under BM25_KEEP, 0.3 of that path's best score, is dropped.

With snippets, a hit keeps its full body only when its fused relevance is at least FULL_BODY_RATIO 0.99 of the top hit. A longer body is clipped to SNIPPET_CHARS 240 and marked body_truncated. Bodies of 960 characters or fewer stay whole.

Stored vectors default to model2vec and minishlab/potion-multilingual-128M.

CAM_HASH_EMBED selects the hash embedder instead of that model.

CAM_REQUIRE_MODEL2VEC refuses the hash fallback when the named model fails to load.

Recall does not walk solution_links. It does follow supersedes to the latest revision.

Bug: after the cam executable on disk is replaced, the running MCP process keeps serving the old build.

Cause: startup records a BinaryStamp of current_exe and its mtime, and the process does not exit when that file later changes.

Change: serverInfo.version is the package version plus the git hash recorded at build time. When a later tool call sees a different mtime, the tool result adds a second text block whose text is exactly cam 已更新，请重启 MCP 服务.

Check: replace the binary, call any tool, and confirm the result has two content blocks and the second block is that sentence. The process is still running.

must: cam 已更新，请重启 MCP 服务

note:
cam recall fuses BM25 and vectors with reciprocal rank fusion. The constant k is 60, and the fused score is scaled by k+1 so a document that is first on both lists scores 2.

A separate mechanism forgets. Ebbinghaus stability S starts at 7 days. A successful recall sets S to S * 1.7. needs_update becomes true when retention falls below 0.3.

cam read returns an outline for a file path and the symbol body for a symbol path. The full flag reads the whole file only when the argument is a file path, not a symbol path.

Unrelated policy: memories are never deleted. Replacing one uses cam add --supersedes with the old id. parent only places the memory in the structural tree.
